ModMetaData.name: Yet another Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: szszss,assssssqwww
ModMetaData.description:
[b]Yet another Optimizer[/b] YetAnotherOptimizer (YaOpt) is a performance optimization mod for RimWorld. It uses Harmony patches and targeted caching to improve FPS and TPS, keeping large late-game colonies running smoothly. All optimizations can be toggled and adjusted individually by category in the in-game mod settings.
[hr][/hr] [b]Changes from 1.6 to 1.7[/b] [list] [*][b]Removed optimizations with poor mod compatibility, including multithreading optimizations.[/b] [*][b]Removed optimizations that no longer apply to 1.7.[/b] [*][b]Rewrote many optimizations for the 1.7 codebase.[/b] [*][b]Added a large number of optimizations, including pathfinding job and grid optimizations, Extended Stat Caching, Alert Update Throttling, Fast Def XPath Predicates, and Def Lookup Index.[/b] [/list]
[hr][/hr] [b]Effect on Saves[/b] This mod does not affect saves. It can be added to an existing save or safely removed at any time. Most optimizations preserve vanilla calculation results; the few that change vanilla behavior are noted in the settings. Most options take effect immediately; options marked "requires a save reload or game restart" take effect after loading a save or restarting the game.
[b]Compatibility[/b] Compatible with most optimization mods for 1.7, including [WG] WOWGAG's Performance Patch, Performance Esmolas, and Overclock. If you find an incompatibility, please report it.
